assembly_notes: Fit the PCB and optical sensor in their intended locations; keep the BLE antenna clear of metal and verify charging-contact alignment.
Close the shells with M2.5 screws, controlling torque to avoid stripping the plastic bosses; install the strap and check pin-hole fit.
Perform a functional test of BLE pairing, heart-rate sensing, IMU response, charging, and battery protection; run a brief burn-in and recheck operation.
Handle and protect LiPo cells against puncture, short circuit, and overheating; ship cells by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
